using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution;
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Orchestration;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Functions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ChatCompletion;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution.Tests
{
    public class ReActEngineTests
    {
        private class TestKernelFunction : KernelFunction
        {
            private readonly string _response;

            public TestKernelFunction(string response) : base(null!, null!, null!)
            {
                _response = response;
            }

            public override Task<SKContext> InvokeAsync(IKernel kernel, KernelArguments arguments)
            {
                var context = new SKContext(null!, null!, null!);
                context.Variables.Set("result", _response);
                return Task.FromResult(context);
            }
        }

        private class TestKernel : Kernel
        {
            public TestKernel() : base() { }

            public override IEnumerable<KernelFunction> GetFunctions()
            {
                yield return new KernelFunction(null!, "Plugin", "Func", new List<ParameterView>(), null!);
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetNextStepAsync_LogsDebugResponse_WhenLoggerIsEnabledForDebug()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);

            var kernelMock = new Mock<IKernel>();
            var config = new FlowOrchestratorConfig();

            // We create a dummy KernelFunction that returns a fixed response
            var reActFunction = new TestKernelFunction("Response text");

            // We create a derived class to inject the KernelFunction and override GetAvailableFunctions and ParseResult
            var reActEngine = new TestableReActEngine(kernelMock.Object, loggerMock.Object, config, reActFunction);

            var arguments = new KernelArguments();
            var question = "What is the answer?";
            var previousSteps = new List<ReActStep>();

            // Act
            var step = await reActEngine.GetNextStepAsync(kernelMock.Object, arguments, question, previousSteps);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug), Times.AtLeastOnce);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Debug,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Response :")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestableReActEngine : ReActEngine
        {
            private readonly KernelFunction _testReActFunction;

            public TestableReActEngine(IKernel kernel, ILogger logger, FlowOrchestratorConfig config, KernelFunction reActFunction)
                : base(kernel, logger, config)
            {
                _testReActFunction = reActFunction;
            }

            protected override IEnumerable<KernelFunction> GetAvailableFunctions(IKernel kernel)
            {
                // Return multiple functions to avoid early return
                return new[]
                {
                    new KernelFunction(null!, "Plugin1", "Func1", new List<ParameterView>(), null!),
                    new KernelFunction(null!, "Plugin2", "Func2", new List<ParameterView>(), null!)
                };
            }

            protected override ReActStep ParseResult(string llmResponseText)
            {
                return new ReActStep { Action = "someAction" };
            }

            internal override KernelFunction ReActFunction => _testReActFunction;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution.Tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogDebug_ExtensionMethod_LogsCorrectly()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);

            string loggedMessage = null!;
            object[] loggedArgs = null!;
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Debug,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) =>
                {
                    loggedMessage = v.ToString()!;
                    return true;
                }),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()))
                .Callback<LogLevel, EventId, object, Exception?, Func<object, Exception?, string>>(
                    (level, eventId, state, exception, formatter) =>
                    {
                        loggedArgs = state.GetType().GetProperty("Arguments")?.GetValue(state) as object[];
                    });

            var action = "TestAction";

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogDebug("Auto selecting {Action} as it is the only function available and it has no parameters.", action);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug), Times.Once);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Debug,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<object>(),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<object, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.NotNull(loggedMessage);
            Assert.Contains("Auto selecting", loggedMessage);
            Assert.NotNull(loggedArgs);
            Assert.Contains(action, Array.ConvertAll(loggedArgs, a => a?.ToString()));
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution.Tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogDebug_ExtensionMethod_LogsCorrectly()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);

            object? loggedState = null;
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Debug,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<object>(),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<object, Exception?, string>>()))
                .Callback<LogLevel, EventId, object, Exception?, Func<object, Exception?, string>>(
                    (level, eventId, state, exception, formatter) =>
                    {
                        loggedState = state;
                    });

            var action = "TestAction";

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogDebug("Auto selecting {Action} as it is the only function available and it has no parameters.", action);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug), Times.Once);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Debug,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<object>(),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<object, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.NotNull(loggedState);
            var stateType = loggedState!.GetType();
            var message = stateType.GetProperty("Message")?.GetValue(loggedState) as string;
            var args = stateType.GetProperty("Arguments")?.GetValue(loggedState) as object[];

            Assert.NotNull(message);
            Assert.Contains("Auto selecting", message);
            Assert.NotNull(args);
            Assert.Contains(action, Array.ConvertAll(args!, a => a?.ToString()));
        }
    }
}
